start_from: original M3Diff base, not r64 adapter
controls: same uses exact same PNG pixels; JPEG B is recompressed then stored PNG; lighting changes gamma only
camera_caption_policy: CAPTION_POLICY.json; canonical3prefixes only for generated camera captions
replay_sampling: Seeded sampling from all official train, unique ordered image pairs/IDs. Existing r64 replay not excluded; report overlap count. No val/test paths or decoded-RGB overlap with selected259val images.
scope: Same caption SFT recipe family as r64. One package of data changes, not attribution to individual components. No SCST or contrastive loss.
incomplete_or_budget_stop: Stop; no model promotion and no automatic second training attempt. Preserve incomplete artifacts without treating them as a passed candidate.
full1570: Only after all gates pass AND a separate admission check shows it fits the same7USD round cap. No promise of full test if remaining budget is insufficient.
